verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is largely API-first. Its core lifecycle is documented as REST endpoints: card enrollment (POST /acp/v1/tokens), purchase intents with mandates and cancellation (POST /acp/v1/instructions), and scoped credential retrieval. These are also exposed through an official MCP server and agent toolkit. However, onboarding runs through a self-serve web sign-up form, with account setup emailed for the Test Enterprise Business Center UI, and dispute handling stops at evidence capture with no dispute API; nothing documents that every UI action has an API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API-based onboarding and account provisioning, a dispute/refund management API, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
